scope: Synthetic recipe export and independent fresh-process Blender scene reopen

method.exports: Run blender/export_scene.py for each recipe in a new background process and a new output directory.
method.reopen: Open each generated scene.blend in another new background process, with UI loading and embedded script execution disabled.
method.independent_check: Read actual mesh vertices, object transforms and editable source curves from the reopened Blender scene. Compare with original recipe dimensions and profiles without importing the geometry generator.
method.curve_edit_check: Modify a source-curve point in memory, verify the change, then restore it without resaving the scene.
method.pass_evidence: Actual scene files and fresh-process readback results, not the asynchronous launcher shell exit code.

verified_properties: Separate, correctly named mesh and source-profile objects
Metre vertex coordinates, metric scene units and millimetre UI display
Expected Z-up local bounds, explicit part translation and no extra scale or rotation
Triangulated meshes and expected source-status metadata
Cyclic POLY source curves preserving equivalent closed material-section boundaries
Editable source-curve coordinates, not only generated mesh geometry
Two incident faces per material mesh edge and positive signed material volume
No external image dependencies in the inspected scenes

test_corrections.initial_set_result: 30/31: the checker initially treated an equivalent reversed closed profile as different.
test_corrections.correction: Accept cyclic and reversed traversal of the same closed profile, matching the geometry validator's legitimate winding normalization.

limits.curve_visibility: Source profiles are initially hidden from viewport and render; their editable datablocks were verified.
limits.precision_interpretation: Numeric tolerance checks preservation of synthetic input coordinates, not physical measurement accuracy.
limits.engineering_interpretation: Material topology and signed material volume do not certify container capacity, lid fit, leakage, manufacturing accuracy or food-contact safety.
limits.scene_hash_interpretation: Hashes identify the exact local acceptance artifacts; byte-identical regeneration of Blender scene files is not claimed.
